survey: A small wooden pier seen from above at an angle, running from the beach out into shallow water. The deck is a row of planks laid crosswise and fixed with metal bolts. A fascia beam runs along the front edge. The deck rests on two rows of round posts. The front row is four posts: the left one stands in the sand, and the other three stand in the water with splash rings where they enter it. The back row is visible under the deck and stands in the water too. The post tops rise a little above the deck as bollards. At the left, the deck's landward end sits on the sand, so the pier is connected to the shore. A taller post stands at the back right corner, at the outer end. A red and white life ring hangs in front of the middle front post from a short rope looped over the post top. A coil of rope is wrapped around the front right post and has no loose ends. In the card view, the life ring's reflection in the water is in the right place for the ring's height.
